text:
In the first scene, I find myself gazing into a glass-walled meeting room. A single figure is seated inside, absorbed in thought or perhaps worry, head in hand. The sparse arrangement of chairs and emptiness magnify the feeling of isolation. I sense a quiet, almost clinical detachment—it is as if the transparency of the glass separates me not just physically, but existentially, challenging me to consider my own place among others.

Moving to the next scene, I am suddenly confronted with a vibrant wall of ideas. Colors and patterns pulse with energy, and the bold R+D lettering draws my attention. This feels more alive, full of potential and curiosity. Information, innovation, and human striving are on display; I am inspired by this tangible testament to minds reaching forward. The contrast is striking: between stillness and motion, solitude and connected learning. I feel the urge to participate, to question, and to create.
